versions.subject: fix: typo in rule
versions.detection:
selection_cmd1:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'cmd.exe /c '
        - ' -p 0x'
selection_cmd2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'C:\ProgramData\\'
        - 'C:\RECYCLER\\'
selection_rundll1:
    CommandLine|contains|all: 
        - 'rundll32.exe '
        - 'C:\ProgramData\\'
selection_rundll2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.bin,'
        - '.tmp,'
        - '.dat,'
        - '.io,'
        - '.ini,'
        - '.db,'
condition: ( selection_cmd1 and selection_cmd2 ) or ( selection_rundll1 and selection_rundll2 )
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*cmd.exe /c *" CommandLine="* -p 0x*" CommandLine IN ("*C:\\ProgramData\\*", "*C:\\RECYCLER\\*")) OR (CommandLine="*rundll32.exe *" CommandLine="*C:\\ProgramData\\*" CommandLine IN ("*.bin,*", "*.tmp,*", "*.dat,*", "*.io,*", "*.ini,*", "*.db,*"))
